summary: WordPress core 7.2 (PHP/MySQL) content-management system: authors create and edit posts with revisions and media attachments; readers comment (with moderation); accounts can self-register; admins manage taxonomy, user accounts, site options/settings, and (in multisite) network sites and signups. Auth is the classic wp_users/wp_usermeta password model; roles live in the wp_capabilities usermeta row. Single-file roles: administrator + author/owner scoping. Privacy data-export/erasure requests follow a pending -> confirmed -> completed lifecycle.
